{{Quote|You're worth quite a bit of money. So wake up.|Gand bounty hunter to Connor Freeman|<ref name="BT2" />}}
This '''unnamed [[Gand/Legends|Gand]]''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who tried to collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Connor Freeman]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who owed a lot of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to a powerful [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Tayand]]. The bounty hunter tracked Freeman to a [[Freeman Cantina|bar]], who was [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] on the bar's counter. Freeman, however, managed to evade capture; assisted by the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Quinny/Legends|Quinny]], who handed him a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], Freeman shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the bounty hunter.<ref name="BT2" />
